```{r}
library(tidyverse)

pharmac <- read.csv("Data_ByTG2_Regional.csv")
census  <- read.csv("census2023.csv")

glimpse(pharmac)
```


```{r}
glimpse(census)
```
```{r}
antidep <- pharmac %>%
  filter(TherapeuticGrp2 == "Antidepressants", District != "New Zealand")

nrow(antidep)                 
sum(antidep$NumPpl == "<6") 
```
```{r}
antidep <- antidep %>%
  mutate(NumPpl = as.numeric(NumPpl))
```

```{r}
antidep <- antidep %>%
  mutate(District = if_else(District %in% c("Capital & Coast", "Hutt Valley"),
                            "Capital, Coast and Hutt Valley", District)) %>%
  group_by(District, YearDisp) %>%
  summarise(NumPpl = sum(NumPpl), .groups = "drop")

nrow(antidep)        
```

```{r}
census <- census %>%
  filter(Area != "New Zealand") %>%
  mutate(across(-Area, ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .x)))) %>%
  mutate(
    Unemployment_Pct = Employment_Unemployed /
      (Employment_FullTime + Employment_PartTime + Employment_Unemployed) * 100,
    Age30to64_Pct = Age_30to64 / Population * 100
  )
```

```{r}
setdiff(antidep$District, census$Area)   

model_data <- antidep %>%
  left_join(census, by = c("District" = "Area")) %>%
  mutate(
    Patients_Per_1k = NumPpl / Population * 1000,
    Year = factor(YearDisp)
  )

nrow(model_data)                          
sum(is.na(model_data$Population))         
head(model_data)
```

```{r}
# How big are the rates do they change by year?
model_data %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Patients_Per_1k),
            Min  = min(Patients_Per_1k),
            Max  = max(Patients_Per_1k))

# row per district
district_avg <- model_data %>%
  group_by(District) %>%
  summarise(Rate = mean(Patients_Per_1k),
            Unemployment_Pct = first(Unemployment_Pct),
            Age30to64_Pct = first(Age30to64_Pct))

#which districts have the highest and lowest rates?
ggplot(district_avg, aes(x = reorder(District, Rate), y = Rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "District",
       y = "Average antidepressant patients per 1,000 residents (2021-2025)")

# rough first look
ggplot(district_avg, aes(x = Unemployment_Pct, y = Rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Unemployment rate (%)",
       y = "Average antidepressant patients per 1,000 residents")

# Are the two predictors too similar to each other?
cor(district_avg$Unemployment_Pct, district_avg$Age30to64_Pct)
summary(district_avg$Unemployment_Pct)
summary(district_avg$Age30to64_Pct)
```
Model
```{r}
fit <- lm(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct + Age30to64_Pct + Year, data = model_data)
summary(fit)
confint(fit)

# correcting for the same district appearing in 5 years
install.packages(c("sandwich", "lmtest"))
library(sandwich); library(lmtest)
coeftest(fit, vcov = vcovCL(fit, cluster = model_data$District))
coefci(fit, vcov = vcovCL(fit, cluster = model_data$District))

# Residual plot
ggplot(data.frame(fitted = fitted(fit), resid = resid(fit)), aes(fitted, resid)) +
  geom_point() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Fitted patient rate (per 1,000)", y = "Residual")

# without Counties Manukau
fit2 <- lm(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct + Age30to64_Pct + Year,
           data = filter(model_data, District != "Counties Manukau"))
summary(fit2)
```

```{r}
coeftest(fit, vcov = vcovCL(fit, cluster = model_data$District), df = 18)
coefci(fit, vcov = vcovCL(fit, cluster = model_data$District), df = 18)
```
```{r}
install.packages("lmerTest")
library(lmerTest)
summary(lmer(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct + Age30to64_Pct + Year + (1 | District),
             data = model_data))
```

```{r}
mm <- lmer(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct + Age30to64_Pct + Year + (1 | District),
           data = model_data)
cf <- summary(mm)$coefficients
tab <- data.frame(
  Estimate = cf[, "Estimate"],
  SE       = cf[, "Std. Error"],
  Lower    = cf[, "Estimate"] - qt(0.975, cf[, "df"]) * cf[, "Std. Error"],
  Upper    = cf[, "Estimate"] + qt(0.975, cf[, "df"]) * cf[, "Std. Error"],
  p        = cf[, "Pr(>|t|)"]
)
round(tab, 3)
```

```{r}
med <- median(district_avg$Unemployment_Pct)

trend <- model_data %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Unemployment_Pct > med,
                        "Higher unemployment", "Lower unemployment")) %>%
  group_by(Group, YearDisp) %>%
  summarise(Rate = mean(Patients_Per_1k), .groups = "drop")

p3 <- ggplot(trend, aes(YearDisp, Rate, linetype = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Average antidepressant patients per 1,000 residents") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("trend_by_unemployment.png", p3, width = 6.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
model_data <- model_data %>% mutate(YearNum = YearDisp - 2021)

mm_int <- lmer(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct * YearNum + Age30to64_Pct +
                 (1 | District), data = model_data)
summary(mm_int)
```

```{r}
mm_slope <- lmer(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct * YearNum + Age30to64_Pct +
                   (1 + YearNum | District), data = model_data)
summary(mm_slope)
```
```{r}
mm_slope_main <- lmer(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct + Age30to64_Pct + YearNum +
                        (1 + YearNum | District), data = model_data)
summary(mm_slope_main)
confint(mm_slope_main, method = "Wald")
```

```{r}
# Table 1 and Figure 1
district_avg %>% summarise(Min = min(Rate), Median = median(Rate), Max = max(Rate))
district_avg %>% arrange(Rate) %>% mutate(Rate = round(Rate, 1))

# Figure 2
trend %>% mutate(Rate = round(Rate, 1))

# Table 2 intervals (main model)
cf <- summary(mm_slope_main)$coefficients
round(data.frame(Estimate = cf[,1], SE = cf[,2], df = cf[,3],
  Lower = cf[,1] - qt(.975, cf[,3]) * cf[,2],
  Upper = cf[,1] + qt(.975, cf[,3]) * cf[,2], p = cf[,5]), 3)

# Interaction interval
ci <- summary(mm_slope)$coefficients["Unemployment_Pct:YearNum", ]
ci["Estimate"] + c(-1, 1) * qt(.975, ci["df"]) * ci["Std. Error"]

# Does the district-trend model fit better?
mm_ri <- lmer(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct + Age30to64_Pct + YearNum +
                (1 | District), data = model_data)
anova(mm_ri, mm_slope_main)

# Without Counties Manukau
mm_cm <- lmer(Patients_Per_1k ~ Unemployment_Pct + Age30to64_Pct + YearNum +
                (1 + YearNum | District),
              data = filter(model_data, District != "Counties Manukau"))
summary(mm_cm)$coefficients
```

```{r}
cf <- summary(mm_cm)$coefficients["Unemployment_Pct", ] 
cf["Estimate"] + c(-1, 1) * qt(.975, cf["df"]) * cf["Std. Error"]
```

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(fitted = fitted(mm_slope_main), resid = resid(mm_slope_main)),
             aes(fitted, resid)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Fitted patient rate (per 1,000)", y = "Residual") +
  theme_minimal()

p2
ggsave("residuals_mixed.png", p2, width = 6.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
model_data %>%
  mutate(Residual = resid(mm_slope_main)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Residual))) %>%
  select(District, YearDisp, Residual) %>%
  head(5)
```

nice looking graphs
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)    

# Palette (colour blind friendly)
blue   <- "#0072B2"
orange <- "#D55E00"
navy   <- "#1F3B57"

my_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.title  = element_text(colour = "grey20"),
        axis.text   = element_text(colour = "grey25"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

district_avg <- district_avg %>%
  mutate(District = recode(District, "Tairawhiti" = "Tāirawhiti"))

# Figure 1
p0 <- district_avg %>%
  mutate(District = fct_reorder(District, Rate)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(District, Rate, fill = Unemployment_Pct)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f", Rate)), hjust = -0.25,
            size = 3.3, colour = "grey20") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, end = 0.85,
                       name = "Unemployment rate (%)") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Antidepressant patients per 1,000 residents (2021-2025 average)") +
  my_theme +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.6, "cm"))
ggsave("district_rates_bar.png", p0, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Figure 2: trend
p3 <- ggplot(trend, aes(YearDisp, Rate, colour = Group,
                        linetype = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(data = filter(trend, YearDisp %in% c(2021, 2025)),
            aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", Rate)),
            vjust = -1, size = 3.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Higher unemployment" = orange,
                                 "Lower unemployment"  = blue)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Higher unemployment" = "solid",
                                   "Lower unemployment"  = "longdash")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Higher unemployment" = 16,
                                "Lower unemployment"  = 17)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2021:2025) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(105, 150)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Average antidepressant patients per 1,000 residents",
       colour = NULL, linetype = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  my_theme
ggsave("trend_by_unemployment.png", p3, width = 6.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

#Figure 3: scatterplot
cm <- filter(district_avg, District == "Counties Manukau")

p1 <- ggplot(district_avg, aes(Unemployment_Pct, Rate)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = blue,
              fill = "#A6CEE3", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = navy, size = 3) +
  geom_point(data = cm, colour = orange, shape = 17, size = 4.5) +
  geom_text(data = cm, aes(label = District), colour = orange,
            hjust = 1, nudge_x = -0.1, size = 3.6) +
  labs(x = "Unemployment rate (%)",
       y = "Antidepressant patients per 1,000 residents (2021-2025 average)") +
  my_theme
ggsave("scatter_unemployment.png", p1, width = 6.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

# Figure 4
resid_df <- model_data %>%
  mutate(District = recode(District, "Tairawhiti" = "Tāirawhiti"),
         fitted = fitted(mm_slope_main),
         resid  = resid(mm_slope_main),
         big    = rank(-abs(resid)) <= 5,
         label  = paste(District, YearDisp))

p2 <- ggplot(resid_df, aes(fitted, resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(data = filter(resid_df, !big), colour = blue,
             size = 2.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = filter(resid_df, big), colour = orange,
             shape = 17, size = 3.8) +
  geom_text_repel(data = filter(resid_df, big), aes(label = label),
                  size = 3.3, colour = "grey20", min.segment.length = 0) +
  labs(x = "Fitted patient rate (per 1,000)", y = "Residual") +
  my_theme
ggsave("residuals_mixed.png", p2, width = 6.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)


p0
p1
p2
p3
```
